content:
Tax now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` was a stub that raised `NotImplementedError`, so I implemented it rather than changing an existing rounding mode. It multiplies the amount in cents by the rate, rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and returns an `int`. The rate goes through `Decimal(str(rate))`, so a float rate like `0.0825` doesn't pick up binary float error.

An EngramDB decision from March 2026 said to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and not half-up. I took your instruction as superseding it and updated that memory to say finance reversed the decision.
